From: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
To: marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com, tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 05 Nov 2025 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: RFP: PR + Design + Event services for Q1 product launch — evaluation plan

Team —

Attached is the RFP packet for our Q1 product launch (see attachment: Q1_launch_RFP_2025.pdf). We need to firm up a shortlist of agencies and vendors to invite to a 30‑minute presentation the week of Nov 17. High level asks: PR retainer, launch creative and assets (hero video + one pager), and on‑site event logistics for a 600‑attendee partner/customer event in SF.

Please review the timeline on page 2 and the scoring criteria in scoring_rubric.xlsx. My proposal for selection cadence:
- 11/05: Send RFP to shortlisted agencies (PR + design + event)
- 11/12: Receive proposals
- 11/17–11/19: Agency presentations (30 min)
- 11/21: Scoring and decision; procurement kick-off following approval

Action items: Marcus — confirm available budget ceiling and preferred procurement route (reserved budget vs. new vendor onboarding). Tessa — please own scheduling the presentations and send the scoring rubric to the agencies; include Stephanie for comms alignment. Stephanie — flag any legal or branding constraints we should bake into the selection criteria.

We will loop in Michael from procurement once we have a preferred vendor for contract negotiation.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Product Marketing
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q1_launch_RFP_2025.pdf
From: marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com

Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com, tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 05 Nov 2025 09:34:22 -0800
Subject: Re: RFP: PR + Design + Event services for Q1 product launch — evaluation plan

Lauren —

Thanks for the packet. Quick budget signal: we have up to $220k for the launch line item if we consolidate PR + creative + event under one prime vendor; otherwise plan for a two‑vendor split with $140k / $80k. I recommend we prioritize agencies that can handle integrated delivery (PR + creative + events) to reduce overhead.

I’ll check with finance on whether we can treat this as a blanket SOW under our existing marketing master services agreement or if we need a new vendor code. Will update by EOD 11/06.

—Marcus
Head of Growth
Redwood Inference

Lauren

Subject: Re: RFP: PR + Design + Event services for Q1 product launch — next steps

All —

Great progress. Current shortlist after first pass: LarkPR (integrated PR + event partnerships), Studio Halo (creative + video partner), and Umbrella Expos (recommended by Studio Halo for logistics).

Confirmed slots: Nov 17 morning reserved for Studio Halo; Nov 18 morning for LarkPR. Tessa — please confirm Zoom invites and include the 15‑minute prep call for vendors 48 hours prior.

Procurement: Michael, please confirm whether we can onboard LarkPR under the existing Marketing MSA or if we need a new vendor code. Marcus — if $220k stands as the preferred ceiling for an integrated vendor, I’ll recommend contracting LarkPR to handle PR + event production and Studio Halo as a creative sub to keep video costs predictable. If procurement/legal require separate vendor entities we’ll run a two‑vendor SOW.

Final note: Stephanie, please review the scoring rubric for brand compliance and flag any items that could meaningfully disqualify a vendor (e.g., use of unapproved imagery, third‑party data usage).

I’ll circulate the evaluation template and a short exec brief by Monday.

—Lauren
